latest_release.name: v1.4.0: The launcher overhaul with a console mode / 启动器大改版与主机模式
latest_release.body:
**v1.4.0: The launcher overhaul with a console mode / 启动器大改版与主机模式**

## English

**Highlights**

**Launcher overhaul (#1097, #1129)**
- Light and System appearance on the Mac, settings in four sections and game options in four groups
- A staged build queue, direct install of built games, game data transfers, save import and export, players and a cloud save conflict choice
- Console mode for the couch: home rows, game pages, search, builds and a Home menu that pauses a game in the background
- Supported games list, stick deadzones and new languages: Spanish, Korean and Brazilian Portuguese

Code by @thehobbit85, @Haseenesss, @zatteogit, @Koshindai, @loki-inu, @rborkow, @LNPANDY, @ZhaowTao, @MartinMajewski, @mbanusic, @TeeJayBaker and @yazzang-homelab. The console concept is by @Koshindai (#816) and the controller interaction and Home menu by @Haseenesss (#901, #952). Ideas by @IUMonster (#658) and @zatteogit (#453).

**New**
- **Staged batch builds and Install built games**: "Build selected" stages the queue for manual start, iOS batches sign and install once at the end, and direct install adds "Install built games" without rebuilding (#1211)
- **macOS Game Mode**: per-game launch option on the Mac (#1189, #1069)
- **Settings that differ from the tested value are marked**: a dot shows next to them, and "Use tested values" puts them back (#453, @zatteogit)
- **Supported games**: reachable from the library header and from console mode, with each game's cover (#1129, #1140, #1195)
- **Game names from the package**: the launcher reads a game's name, package version and control data from its package itself, including renamed XCI files, and surfaces a dismissable skipped-files banner (#1125, #895, #1172, #1195, #1212)
- **Preflight checks and signing limit guidance**: key and disk checks run before a build starts, and Apple error `9120` explains the 10-App-ID weekly free-account limit (#1170, #1188)
- **iPhone and iPad shell**: saves, players, data folder diagnostics, a Hold or Toggle mode for each touch key (idea by @IUMonster, #658), the Switch 2 badge, a cloud save gate and a Steam Link fallback. The controller's Options button opens the shell settings, and the in-game menu speaks the player's language (#1129, #1164)
- **Accessibility in the launcher**: labels, native switches and Reduce Motion (#627, #628, #629, @zatteogit)
- **Settings gear fades out**: on iPhone and iPad it hides after 3 idle seconds with a controller (#1029)
- **Builds that end in console mode are recorded** (#950, @Haseenesss)

**Changed**
- **Engine**: the pin moves to `81906931` (Switch 2 controllers, mesh object function, M1 iOS build, #1063), `ab41d6a1` (#1125, #1142) and `ccd834e0` (56 more upstream commits including raw HID first-press joining, Ocarina NDVE direct movie scaling and fallback app icons, #1193, #1196). The engine no longer needs .NET (#1125), and the obsolete manual Joy-Con split toggle is removed now that Bluetooth Joy-Con pair natively (#1220)
- **Experimental engine is never older than Stable**: when it is not ahead, the engine update row says so and offers Back to Stable (#1127, #1095)
- **Experimental builder**: stays behind its feature toggle, off for now (#993)

**Fixed**
- **Super Mario Party post-ring crash**: `post_put` waits for an unclaimed slot in a 1024-entry post ring instead of overwriting pending fences (#1220, seedds/nxnative#2469)
- **Joy-Con**: driver, IMU axes, gyro, paired left and right Core Haptics channels and single-handle locality routing (#1072, #1074, #1075, #1083, #1158, #1220, seedds/nxnative#2472)
- **Pro Controller counted twice**: one Pro Controller is one pad again and keeps its gyro (#972, #971, @Haseenesss)
- **External ExFAT drives and post-build cleanup**: free-space checks fall back to `statfs` when macOS reports zero bytes on ExFAT (#1185, #1155), and builds clean up duplicate `romfs.img` and staging files afterwards (#1146, #1148)
- **Shader split hung at 99%**: zstd is decompressed in-process (#10

detail.readme:
**Your Switch games, running on your iPhone.** **Not an emulator. No terminal. A macOS or Windows app does the whole build in a few clicks.** [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/network/members) [![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](LICENSE) [![Games](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FLNPANDY%2FNX2Apple%2Fmain%2F.github%2Fbadges%2Fgames.json)](.github/badges/games.json) [![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇨🇳_中文-available-green)](README.zh-CN.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇺🇸_English-current-blue)](README.md) [![Svenska](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇸🇪_Svenska-available-green)](README.sv.md) [![Deutsch](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇩🇪_Deutsch-available-green)](README.de.md) [![Français](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇫🇷_Français-available-green)](README.fr.md) [![Italiano](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇮🇹_Italiano-available-green)](README.it.md) #### 🆕 Latest highlights - **Windows launcher (`NX2Apple-windows-x64.zip`)**: Build iPhone and iPad IPAs on Windows with the same 1.2 interface, a bundled engine tree (no git needed), guided first-run setup, multi-core NSO rewriting, and in-app self-update (`NX2Apple.exe`). - **Switch 2 games**: Pick a Switch 2 game folder or `.nup` file in the Mac or Windows launcher, with no `prod.keys` needed, and play on Mac, iPhone, or iPad. - **Custom touch controls, split Joy-Con, and Steam Controller (2026)**: Resize buttons, move the left stick, or arrange every control in the visual layout editor on iPhone and iPad. Physical controllers support per-game or global button remapping, split a Bluetooth Joy-Con pair into two sideways controllers on Mac, and support the Steam Controller (2026). - **One app for iPhone and iPad**: All your games live inside one shell app (or export an unsigned IPA for AltStore and SideStore), each carrying its own host framework so engine updates never force a rebuild, with Cover Flow in landscape, per-game settings and mods, safe game deletion that keeps your saves, and 7 languages. - **Console mode**: Plug in a controller and press Select, or start directly in console mode. The library goes full-screen like a Switch home menu, and holding Home for 2 seconds quits a game. Every release is in the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md).
--- ## What NX2Apple is NX2Apple runs Nintendo Switch games on your Mac and iPhone from your own game dumps. It is not an emulator: the game's own code runs natively on Apple silicon, and Metal draws it. A Mac app, the launcher, does the build in a few clicks (unpack, rewrite, translate the shaders, pack) and then keeps your games in a library you start with **Play**, the way a Switch does. It is a community fork of **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)**, which does the actual work (the code rewriter, the Horizon host, NVN on Metal and every game's profile); this fork adds the launcher and a short list of patches, and follows nxnative every day. ## Requirements - **An Apple silicon Mac.** The launcher opens on **macOS 13 or later**. Building needs Xcode with the iOS SDK, and NVN games need [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/download/all/?q=Xcode%2027.2) 27.2 (macOS 26.6 or later) unless built with `--allow-other-metal`. Take 27.2 from Apple's download page, not the App Store's newer Xcode. With both installed, give 27.2 a distinct name such as `Xcode-27.2.app`. In **Settings → Build tools → Choose Xcode…**, select the copy to use with NX2Apple, including one on an external drive. During first-run setup, click **Set up later** to reach Settings, then **Run setup again** after choosing Xcode. **Use system Xcode** follows the Mac's command-line selection (for example, `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode-27.2.app`). - **Your own game dumps** (NSP or XCI) and **your own `prod.keys`** from your own console. Nothing is bundled, downloaded or looked up for you. The same `prod.keys` opens every one of your Switch games. A current dump covers all retail titles. Switch 2 games (a game folder or `.nup` file) do not need `prod.keys`. - For an iPhone or iPad: iOS or iPadOS 26 or later and a recent device. Older devices are untested. The app carries its own build tools and Python, so no Homebrew and no Python install; the .NET SDK 10 is the one tool it still installs for you. The launcher's dependency page checks each requirement and installs what it can with one click. ## Install 1. **Download the app**: `NX2Apple-macOS-arm64.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/releases/latest). Unzip it. 2. **Open it once with right-click, then Open.** The app is not signed with a paid Apple developer certificate, so macOS asks before the first start; after that it opens normally. 3. **Follow the setup.** The launcher fetches the project it builds with (a **Download repository** button on the setup page, a shallow clone into `~/NX2Apple`; if GitHub is slow, the page shows the manual ZIP route), checks the tools above and updates itself later. You never need git. 4. **Build a game.** Pick the game's folder (or its base game, update, DLC and `prod.keys` one by one), choose **This Mac** or **iPhone / iPad**, and press build. The page shows the real stages and the time left, and a stopped build continues where it left off. The **iPhone / iPad** target is one app on the device for all your games. The launcher signs it with Xcode, installs it and copies the game in. It needs a device paired with the Mac. Building by hand from a terminal is in [BUILDING.md](BUILDING.md). **Updating a Mac game you already built.** Select the game in the library and choose **Rebuild**. For an update NSP, keep the base game selected and choose the new NSP in **Updates & add-on content**. Build for **This Mac** in the same output folder. The update can change both game code and data, so the launcher builds the new version and reuses cached work where it can. Your saves stay in their existing folder outside the `.app`, keyed by the game's title ID. Rebuilding in the same library keeps that progress. ## The iPhone and iPad app The **iPhone / iPad** target builds one shell app that holds all your games, the way the Mac launcher does. Its library shows each game with its key art. In portrait it is one column with the chosen game at the top. On its side it is a Cover Flow. An iPad shows a grid. - **Add games from the Mac.** Build a game with the **iPhone / iPad** target and the launcher copies it into the app. Re-signing and reinstalling the app keeps your game data and saves. - **Play.** Pick a game and tap **Play**. A game that is missing its data, or needs a newer app, says so on its card and offers the fix. - **Settings for each game.** The settings button (or X on a controller) opens that game's launch options. **Reset** puts every choice back to its default. - **Controller or keyboard.** The whole app works from a controller: the D-pad and stick move, A picks, B goes back, X opens the settings and Y lists the controllers. A hardware keyboard works the same way. - **Game data folder.** Each game can read its data from a folder you pick in the Files app, for example on an external drive, or from the app's own folder. - **Cloud saves.** Pick an iCloud Drive folder for a game's saves to keep them in step with the Mac. - **Language.** The app follows the system language, English or Simplified Chinese. The app needs iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. The covers are the eShop banners the Mac launcher caches for your own games. ## How to play **On the Mac**, a finished game appears in the library with its key art. **Play** starts it. **Launch options** (per game, kept across rebuilds) set the frame rate, console mode (docked or handheld), render scale and upscaling, game language, controls and more; what each does is in [docs/settings.md](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/settings.md). A controller drives the launcher as well as the games. **On the iPhone**, the app shows the same settings before the game starts; tap **Play**. Touch controls come in a 2D and a 3D layout (tap the button at the top centre), and a connected controller (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, MFi) replaces them. [docs/playing.md](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/playing.md) covers touch, rumble and motion. Short stutters the first time a scene appears are normal: the app compiles graphics for it once and remembers them. The game's data (`romfs.img`) can live on an external drive that the Files app picks. **Game language.** On the Mac, a game that has your Mac's language starts in it: the **Game language** row of Launch options preselects it until you pick another, and **Reset to tested defaults** goes back to it. A game without your Mac's language, a game built in another language (`LANGUAGE`), and every iPhone build start in the build's language, English by default. For anything the sheet lacks, write an `env.txt` of `KEY=VALUE` lines (for example `DM_LANG=zh-Hans`) in one of two places: `~/Library/Application Support/nxnative//env.txt` wins and survives rebuilds; `<App>.app/Contents/Resources/dm/env.txt` is the app's own. A Mac app built before the language row existed needs one rebuild to get it. On the iPhone, the same lines go in `Documents/env.txt` (`DM_FPS_TARGET=30` caps the frame rate to save battery, `DM_OPMODE=0` picks handheld mode). That file applies to every game in the shared app. For a line that belongs to one game (a mod's `DM_ROMFS_OVERLAY`, for example), write it in `Documents/games/<title ID>/env.txt`. Where both files set a key, the game's file wins. A mod is easier: put its folder in `Documents/games/<title ID>/mods/<mod name>/` (the RomFS files in a `romfs/` folder inside it, or in the folder itself). The shell then sets `DM_ROMFS_OVERLAY` for that game only. If there are several mods, the one first by name wins where they replace the same file. Where the same key is set twice, the order is: the shell's own settings, the game's `env.txt`, the game's `mods/` folder, the shared `Documents/env.txt`. **Saves and logs.** A Mac game in a library folder keeps its saves and its log beside the app (`log/<title ID>.log`); otherwise they are in `~/Library/Application Support/nxnative/<title ID>/` and `~/Library/Logs/nxnative/<title ID>.log`. On the iPhone they are in the Files app under the app's name: `save/` and `log.txt` (the previous run is `log.prev.txt`). **Reporting a bug.** Use the [issue forms](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues/new/choose) (game problem, build problem, launcher problem). Each asks for the game and its title ID, your versions and device, **Settings > Copy diagnostics** and the game's log; [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) says why. A report with the full `log.txt` is looked at first. Never attach keys, game files or anything extracted from a game. ## Games 147 games have a profile. Many are reported playable on an iPhone upstream, and most have a profile that has not been tried on a phone yet. A few of them: | | Game | Where it runs | Status | |---|---|---|---| | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom | Mac and iPhone | **Verified here**: 304,243 files, byte-checked; ~17 GB | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/hades-ii.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | Hades II | Mac and iPhone | **Verified here** | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/animal-crossing-new-horizons.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | Animal Crossing: New Horizons | iPhone | **Verified here**: runs smoothly | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/super-mario-odyssey.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | Super Mario Odyssey | iPhone | Reported playable upstream | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/zelda-breath-of-the-wild.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild | iPhone | Reported playable upstream; 60 fps with 1.9.0 | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/mario-kart-8-deluxe.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | Mario Kart 8 Deluxe | iPhone | Reported playable upstream | **[GAMES.md](GAMES.md)** has the screenshot gallery with each game's install size, and the full table with the update version each game needs: the update NSP's display version must match the profile's, or the build says so. **Switch 2 games** are new in the engine. Eleven have a profile, all marked as playing on the Mac by upstream: Donkey Kong Bananza, Splatoon Raiders, Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave, Pokémon Pokopia, Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment, Mario Kart World, Mario Tennis Fever, Star Fox, Yoshi and the Mysterious Book, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and Kirby Air Riders. Choose the game's folder of files (`base/`, `updates/`, `dlc/`) or its `.nup` file on the Builds page. No `prod.keys` are needed for them. The library marks them **Switch 2**. Only Donkey Kong Bananza was tried on this fork. The owner built and played it through the launcher on a Mac, an iPhone and an iPad, with no problems on the Mac and the iPhone and almost none on the iPad. The other Switch 2 games were not tried here. [GAMES.md](GAMES.md#switch-2-games) has the details. ## Limitations - **Only the games with a profile.** A title outside the list needs bring-up work of its own; the place to start is [docs/agents](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/agents/README.md), upstream's guide for another Switch title. - **Big games on an iPhone hit a memory limit.** Without the Increased Memory Limit entitlement iOS gives the app about 3.4 GB, which is not enough for Tears of the Kingdom. The app requests it, and AltStore Classic 2.2+, Impactor and Xcode with a Personal Team keep it; SideStore with a free Apple ID needs a one-time App ID fix, and Sideloadly drops it ([the steps](ENTITLEMENTS.md)). The full measurements are in [GAMES.md](GAMES.md#verified-on). - **Unsigned launcher.** The launcher is not signed for you, so you sideload it. The iPhone app is signed by Xcode with your own team when the launcher installs it. - **Your own files.** No game data, firmware or keys are included or downloaded. - **Older shard archives are not read any more.** The first iPhone builds packed Tears of the Kingdom into a RomFS shard archive (`romfs.idx`); the build writes a single `romfs.img` now. An iPhone that still holds an old archive needs the game data sent again once, as a `romfs.img` through the launcher. ## For developers - **Build from source:** [BUILDING.md](BUILDING.md). **Report or fix something:** [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). - **Where help is wanted:** the [milestones](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/milestones) are the plan, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#where-we-would-love-help) says how to take an issue from one. - **We are looking for one or two more developers.** There is a lot to do. If you want to join us, take an open issue from a milestone and send a well made pull request. People who deliver good work, again and again, are asked to help with reviews and triage. - **What this fork changes in upstream:** the engine (`dm/`, `scripts/`, `docs/`, `ref/`) is not committed here. It is nxnative at a pinned commit (`.upstream-ref`) plus a queue of patches, each saying why the fork carries it, and `python3 tools/engine.py sync` builds it into `engine/`. [patches/README.md](patches/README.md) explains it, and `python3 tools/engine.py status` lists what is carried. A daily job moves the pin and opens a pull request, or an issue naming the patch that no longer fits. The links to the engine's documents in this README point at nxnative at the pinned commit. - **Another Switch game:** [docs/agents](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/agents/README.md) (extraction, binary survey, bring-up). - **Release history:** [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## Credits **Community contributors** — this project's code is not one maintainer's output: - **[v0lumehi](https://github.com/v0lumehi)** — **the Mac front end's launcher** (PR [#27](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/pull/27), 40 files): a game library with key art, per-game launch options, a real progress stream, and a Stop that ends the whole build's process group. The Mac app went from "a build form" to the first version of a launcher that opens like a Switch. - **[m1guelpf](https://github.com/m1guelpf)** (Miguel Piedrafita) — two HLE fixes (PRs [#24](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/pull/24) and [#26](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/pull/26)): the missing `EnableAlbumImageTakenNotification` and `CreateWithAdjustableSystemClock` entries plus their snapshot type byte — each would have read a null in games that call them, and each came with a test. Want on this list? [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md#helping-with-games) says how to start; reports with a full log and fixes with a test move fastest. **Community projects** — maintained by their authors, outside this repository: - **[widmonstertony/nxnative](https://github.com/widmonstertony/nxnative)** (`ios16-pokemon-za-port` branch) — iOS/iPadOS 16.1–17 and tvOS compatibility, with a legacy Metal renderer path, tested on an A10X iPad and an M2 iPad. For devices this fork's releases do not support. All of the engine work is other people's. This repository adds the launcher and the patch queue on top: - **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)** (MIT) — the native-execution toolchain this repository is built from: the NSO rewriter, the Horizon host layer, NVN-on-Metal, the per-game profiles and the iOS shell. - **[d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile)** (MIT) — the original native-execution approach that nxnative grew out of. - **Ryujinx** (MIT) — the shader translator that turns Maxwell shaders into SPIR-V. - **[Atmosphère](https://github.com/Atmosphere-NX/Atmosphere)** — the reference for Horizon's synchronization semantics. - **[LibHac](https://github.com/Thealexbarney/LibHac)** — reads NSPs and layers updates in `nx_extract`. - **[SPIRV-Cross](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Cross)** — SPIR-V to Metal Shading Language. - **yuzu**, **deko3d**, **libvpx**, **stb_vorbis**, **libdeflate** — see upstream's acknowledgement list for what each contributes. `dm/third_party` ships other projects with their licenses ([list](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/dm/third_party/README.md)). ## Legal **What this project is.** A build tool for games you already own. It reads dumps you made of your own cartridges and purchases, on your own machine, and produces a package for your own device. Nothing in this repository, in the app, or in any release contains or distributes Nintendo's code, art, text, data, shaders, firmware, keys or any other copyrighted material. **What it cannot do.** The pipeline has no source of games or keys: it requires the user's own `prod.keys` and their own NSP/XCI dumps, and it talks to no server. It does not bypass, strip or redistribute any protection — LibHac opens the user's own dumps with the user's own keys, the same operation a console performs on a cartridge. **Trademarks.** Not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Nintendo. "Nintendo Switch" and game titles are trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd.; all other trademarks belong to their respective owners. **Your responsibility.** Laws on making a personal backup copy differ by country; some places do not allow it at all. You are responsible for knowing and following the law where you live, and for never distributing game files, keys or the packages built from them — the project's outputs are for personal use on your own hardware only. If you enjoy a game, buy it. **Takedowns.** If you believe anything in this repository infringes your rights, open an issue or contact the maintainer directly; valid claims will be actioned promptly, up to removing content or the repository. **No warranty.** The software is provided "as is" under the licenses in [LICENSE](LICENSE) (this fork adds to upstream's; see the credits) — without warranty of any kind, express or implied. Use it at your own risk.

**你的 Switch 游戏，跑在你的 iPhone 上。** **不是模拟器。不用命令行。一个 macOS 或 Windows App 点几下就把整个构建做完。** [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/network/members) [![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](LICENSE) [![游戏](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FLNPANDY%2FNX2Apple%2Fmain%2F.github%2Fbadges%2Fgames.json)](.github/badges/games.json) [![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇨🇳_中文-current-blue)](README.zh-CN.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇺🇸_English-available-green)](README.md) [![Svenska](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇸🇪_Svenska-available-green)](README.sv.md) [![Deutsch](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇩🇪_Deutsch-available-green)](README.de.md) [![Français](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇫🇷_Français-available-green)](README.fr.md) [![Italiano](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇮🇹_Italiano-available-green)](README.it.md) #### 🆕 最近重点更新 - **Windows 版启动器上线（`NX2Apple-windows-x64.zip`）**：在 Windows 上使用与 Mac 版一致的 1.2 界面构建 iPhone 和 iPad IPA，自带完整引擎目录（无需安装 git），支持首次启动引导向导与工具链一键安装、多核并行 NSO 重写及应用内自动更新（`NX2Apple.exe`） - **支持 Switch 2 游戏**：在 Mac 或 Windows 启动器中直接选择 Switch 2 游戏文件夹或 `.nup` 文件，无需 `prod.keys`，即可在 Mac、iPhone 或 iPad 上构建和游玩 - **虚拟手柄自定义、双 Joy-Con 横握拆分与 Steam Controller（2026）**：在 iPhone 和 iPad 的可视化编辑器中自由调整触控按键大小、摇杆位置与整体布局（2D/3D 独立保存）。外接手柄支持全局或按游戏改键，Mac 端支持将一对蓝牙 Joy-Con 拆分为两个独立横握手柄，并支持新款 Steam Controller（2026） - **iPhone 和 iPad 共用一个 App**：所有游戏装进同一个壳 App（也支持导出未签名 IPA），每个游戏自带独立宿主框架（后续引擎更新无需重编旧游戏），支持横屏 Cover Flow、按游戏独立设置与 Mod、保留存档删除游戏，以及 6 种系统语言 - **主机模式**：插上手柄按 Select 或设置开机直达，游戏库即刻变为全屏手柄界面，长按 Home 键 2 秒即可退出游戏 所有版本见[更新日志](CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md)。
--- ## 这是什么 NX2Apple 用你自己导出的游戏文件，在你的 Mac 和 iPhone 上运行 Nintendo Switch 游戏。它不是模拟器： 游戏自己的代码直接在 Apple 芯片上运行，由 Metal 负责绘制。一个 Mac App（启动器）点几下就完成构建 （解包、改写、翻译 shader、打包），然后把你的游戏放进游戏库，像 Switch 一样点 **Play** 启动。 它是 **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)** 的社区 fork。真正的工作（代码改写器、Horizon 宿主层、NVN-on-Metal 和每个游戏的 profile）都是 nxnative 的；本 fork 在其上增加启动器和少量补丁， 并每天跟随 nxnative 更新。 ## 环境要求 - **Apple Silicon Mac。** 启动器支持 **macOS 13 或更新**。构建需要装了 iOS SDK 的 Xcode；NVN 游戏需要 [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/download/all/?q=Xcode%2027.2) 27.2（macOS 26.6 或更新），除非加 `--allow-other-metal`。 请从 Apple 的下载页面获取 27.2，而不是 App Store 里更新的 Xcode。如果同时安装了两个版本，可以把 27.2 改名为 `Xcode-27.2.app`。在**设置 → 构建工具 → 选择 Xcode…** 中选择 NX2Apple 使用的 Xcode，也可以选择外置硬盘上的副本。 首次启动时，可先点**稍后设置**退出向导，选好 Xcode 后在设置页点**再次运行设置**。点**使用系统 Xcode** 可让启动器使用 Mac 的命令行工具设置（例如通过 `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode-27.2.app` 选择的副本）。 - **你自己的游戏文件**（NSP 或 XCI）和**你自己主机里导出的 `prod.keys`**。本项目不自带、不下载、 也不替你查找任何东西。一份 `prod.keys` 能解你所有的 Switch 游戏。新导出的一份覆盖所有零售游戏。 Switch 2 游戏（游戏文件夹或 `.nup` 文件）不需要 `prod.keys`。 - 要装到 iPhone 或 iPad：iOS 或 iPadOS 26 或更新，以及较新的设备。更旧的设备未测试。 App 自带构建工具和 Python，不需要装 Homebrew 和 Python；.NET SDK 10 仍由 App 帮你安装。启动器的依赖页会逐项检查，能装的一键安装。 ## 安装 1. **下载 App**：从[最新版本](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/releases/latest)下载 `NX2Apple-macOS-arm64.zip`，解压。 2. **首次启动：右键 → 打开。** 这个 App 没有付费的 Apple 开发者证书签名，所以 macOS 在第一次启动时会 询问；之后就能正常打开。 3. **按设置页走。** 启动器会取回构建用的项目（设置页上的「下载仓库」按钮，浅克隆到 `~/NX2Apple`； GitHub 不顺手时页面会给出手动 ZIP 的路线），检查上面的工具，之后还会自己更新。全程不需要懂 git。 4. **构建游戏。** 选好游戏文件夹（或者分别选本体、更新包、DLC 和 `prod.keys`），选择「这台 Mac」或 「iPhone / iPad」，按构建。页面显示真实的阶段和剩余时间，中途停止的构建会从上次继续。「iPhone / iPad」 是装在设备上、容纳你所有游戏的一个共用 App。启动器用 Xcode 为它签名、安装并拷入游戏，需要一台与这台 Mac 配对的设备。 在终端里手动构建见 [BUILDING.zh-CN.md](BUILDING.zh-CN.md)。 **更新已构建的 Mac 游戏。** 在游戏库中选中游戏，点「重新构建」。如果更新包是 NSP，保留已选的游戏本体， 在「更新和附加内容」中选择新的更新包，然后在原输出文件夹中为「这台 Mac」构建。更新可能同时改动游戏代码和数据， 因此启动器会构建新版本，并尽量复用缓存。存档按游戏的标题 ID 保存在 `.app` 外的独立文件夹中， 在同一游戏库中重新构建会保留原有进度。 ## iPhone 和 iPad 上的 App 「iPhone / iPad」目标会构建一个共用的外壳 App，和 Mac 启动器一样容纳你所有的游戏。游戏库用封面展示每个游戏。 竖屏时是单列，选中的游戏在顶部。横过来是 Cover Flow。iPad 显示网格。 - **从 Mac 添加游戏。** 用「iPhone / iPad」目标构建游戏，启动器会把它拷进 App。重新签名和重装 App 都会保留游戏数据和存档。 - **游玩。** 选一个游戏，点 **Play**。缺少游戏数据或需要更新 App 的游戏，会在它的卡片上说明并给出解决办法。 - **每个游戏的设置。** 设置按钮（手柄上按 X）打开该游戏的启动选项。**重置**会把所有选择恢复为默认。 - **手柄或键盘。** 整个 App 都能用手柄操作：方向键和摇杆移动，A 选择，B 返回，X 打开设置，Y 列出手柄。外接键盘的用法相同。 - **游戏数据文件夹。** 每个游戏可以从你在「文件」App 里选的文件夹（例如外置硬盘）读取数据，也可以用 App 自己的文件夹。 - **云存档。** 为游戏选一个 iCloud Drive 文件夹，存档就和 Mac 保持同步。 - **语言。** App 跟随系统语言，英文或简体中文。 App 需要 iOS 或 iPadOS 26 或更新。封面是 Mac 启动器为你自己的游戏缓存的 eShop 横幅。 ## 游玩 **在 Mac 上**，构建好的游戏带着封面出现在游戏库里，点 **Play** 启动。**启动选项**（按游戏保存，重新 构建后仍然保留）可设置帧率、主机模式（底座或掌机）、渲染缩放和超分辨率、游戏语言、操控等；每项的 作用见 [docs/settings.md](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/settings.md)（英文）。手柄既能操作游戏，也能操作启动器。 **在 iPhone 上**，App 在游戏开始前显示同样的设置，点 **Play** 即可。触屏操控有 2D 和 3D 两种布局 （点顶部中央的按钮切换），连接手柄（Xbox、PlayStation、Switch Pro、MFi）后触屏控件会隐藏。 触屏、震动和体感见 [docs/playing.md](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/playing.md)（英文）。新场景第一次出现时短促卡顿是正常的： App 会为它编译一次图形并记住。游戏数据（`romfs.img`）可以放在外置硬盘上，用「文件」App 选取。 **游戏语言。** 默认英文。Mac 上用启动选项里的「游戏语言」一行。面板里没有的设置，可以写一个 `env.txt`，每行 `KEY=VALUE`（例如 `DM_LANG=zh-Hans`），放在两处之一： `~/Library/Application Support/nxnative//env.txt` 优先，重新构建后仍在； `<App>.app/Contents/Resources/dm/env.txt` 是 App 自带的。在加入语言选项之前构建的 Mac App 需要重新构建 一次才有该项。iPhone 上同样的行写在 `Documents/env.txt` 里（`DM_FPS_TARGET=30` 限帧省电， `DM_OPMODE=0` 选掌机模式）。该文件对共享 App 里的每个游戏都生效。只属于某一个游戏的行（例如 mod 的 `DM_ROMFS_OVERLAY`）写在 `Documents/games/<title ID>/env.txt` 里。两个文件设置了同一个键时，以该游戏的文件为准。 Mod 更简单：把它的文件夹放进 `Documents/games/<title ID>/mods/<mod 名>/`（RomFS 文件放在其中的 `romfs/` 文件夹里，或直接放在该文件夹里）。之后 Shell 只为这个游戏设置 `DM_ROMFS_OVERLAY`。有多个 mod 时，替换同一文件的 情况下按名称排在前面的生效。同一个键被多处设置时的优先顺序：Shell 自己的设置、该游戏的 `env.txt`、该游戏的 `mods/` 文件夹、共享的 `Documents/env.txt`。 **存档和日志。** 放在游戏库文件夹里的 Mac 游戏，存档和日志在 App 旁边（`log/<title ID>.log`）；否则在 `~/Library/Application Support/nxnative/<title ID>/` 和 `~/Library/Logs/nxnative/<title ID>.log`。 iPhone 上在「文件」App 里该 App 名字下：`save/` 和 `log.txt`（上一次运行的是 `log.prev.txt`）。 **报告问题。** 请用[问题表单](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues/new/choose)（游戏问题、构建问题、 启动器问题）。表单会要你填游戏和 title ID、版本和设备、**设置 > 复制诊断信息**，以及游戏的日志； 为什么需要见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)（英文）。附上完整 `log.txt` 的报告会优先处理。 千万不要附上密钥、游戏文件或任何从游戏中提取的内容。 ## 游戏 共有 147 个游戏 profile。部分游戏上游报告 iPhone 可玩，其余的 profile 还没在手机上试过。其中几款： | | 游戏 | 运行于 | 状态 | |---|---|---|---| | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | 塞尔达传说：王国之泪 | Mac 和 iPhone | **本 fork 验证**：304,243 个文件，逐字节校验；约 17 GB | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/hades-ii.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | Hades II | Mac 和 iPhone | **本 fork 验证** | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/animal-crossing-new-horizons.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | 集合啦！动物森友会 | iPhone | **本 fork 验证**：流畅运行 | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/super-mario-odyssey.jpg" width="96" alt=""> 塞尔达传说：旷野之息 | iPhone | 上游报告可玩；1.9.0 可 60 fps | | <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seedds/nxnative/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/images/mario-kart-8-deluxe.jpg" width="96" alt=""> | 马力欧卡丁车 8 豪华版 | iPhone | 上游报告可玩 | **[GAMES.zh-CN.md](GAMES.zh-CN.md)**（带截图图库和每款的安装大小） 有完整表格和每款游戏需要的更新包版本：更新包 NSP 的显示版本必须与 profile 一致，否则构建会提示。 **Switch 2 游戏**是引擎新加入的。目前有 11 款有 profile，上游都标为可在 Mac 上玩：Donkey Kong Bananza、 Splatoon Raiders、Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave、Pokémon Pokopia、Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment、 Mario Kart World、Mario Tennis Fever、Star Fox、Yoshi and the Mysterious Book、The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 和 Kirby Air Riders。 在构建页面选择游戏文件夹（`base/`、`updates/`、`dlc/`）或它的 `.nup` 文件即可，不需要 `prod.keys`。游戏库会把它们标为 **Switch 2**。本 fork 只试过 Donkey Kong Bananza：所有者通过启动器构建，并在 Mac、iPhone 和 iPad 上玩过，Mac 和 iPhone 上没有发现问题， iPad 上基本没有问题。其他 Switch 2 游戏在本 fork 上没有试过。详情见 [GAMES.zh-CN.md](GAMES.zh-CN.md#switch-2-游戏)。 ## 限制 - **只支持有 profile 的游戏。** 列表之外的游戏需要单独的 bring-up 工作；起点是 [docs/agents](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/agents/README.md)（上游为其他 Switch 游戏写的指南，英文）。 - **大体积游戏在 iPhone 上会碰到内存上限。** 没有 Increased Memory Limit entitlement 时 iOS 只给 App 约 3.4 GB，不够《王国之泪》用。App 请求了它，AltStore Classic 2.2+、Impactor 和 Xcode + Personal Team 会保留；SideStore 配合免费 Apple ID 需要对 App ID 做一次性修复，Sideloadly 会丢掉它 （[步骤](ENTITLEMENTS.md)）。完整的测量见 [GAMES.zh-CN.md](GAMES.zh-CN.md#验证情况)。 - **启动器未签名。** 启动器不会替你签名，需要你自己侧载。iPhone 上的 App 在启动器安装时由 Xcode 用你自己的团队签名。 - **你自己的文件。** 不包含也不下载任何游戏数据、固件或密钥。 - **旧的分片归档不再被读取。** 最早的 iPhone 构建把《王国之泪》打成 RomFS 分片归档（`romfs.idx`）；现在 构建写出单个 `romfs.img`。仍保留旧归档的 iPhone 需要通过启动器把游戏数据重新发送一次（`romfs.img`）。 ## 给开发者 - **从源码构建：** [BUILDING.zh-CN.md](BUILDING.zh-CN.md)。**报告或修复问题：** [CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md)。 - **哪里需要帮忙：** [里程碑](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/milestones)就是计划，怎么从中认领一个 issue 见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#where-we-would-love-help)。 - **本 fork 对上游改了什么：** 引擎（`dm/`、`scripts/`、`docs/`、`ref/`）不提交在本仓库里。它是 nxnative 在固定提交（`.upstream-ref`）上的内容，加一组补丁，每个补丁写明本 fork 为什么带着它， `python3 tools/engine.py sync` 把它构建到 `engine/`。见 [patches/README.md](patches/README.md)。 `python3 tools/engine.py status` 列出带着的全部补丁。每天一次的任务移动固定提交并开 pull request， 某个补丁对不上时开一个点名该补丁的 issue。本页指向引擎文档的链接都指向 nxnative 的固定提交。 - **其他 Switch 游戏：** [docs/agents](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative/blob/ccd834e06a3938834bb5579e2ccc6a0ad13d3970/docs/agents/README.md)（解包、二进制调查、bring-up）。 - **版本历史：** [CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md](CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md)。 ## 致谢 **社区贡献者** —— 这个项目的代码不只是一个维护者的输出： - **[v0lumehi](https://github.com/v0lumehi)** —— **Mac 前端的启动器界面**（PR [#27](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/pull/27)，40 个文件）：游戏库、封面图、每游戏启动选项、真进度流、能真正结束整个构建进程组的 Stop。Mac 端从"一个构建表单"变成了"打开像一台 Switch 的启动器"的第一版。 - **[m1guelpf](https://github.com/m1guelpf)**（Miguel Piedrafita）—— 两个 HLE 修复（PR [#24](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/pull/24)、[#26](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/pull/26)）：补上了 `EnableAlbumImageTakenNotification` 和 `CreateWithAdjustableSystemClock` 及其快照类型字节——两个原本会让游戏读到空指针的缺失条目，各带测试。 想加入这个列表？[参与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md#帮忙补充游戏)写了怎么开始；issue 里附上完整日志的报告和带测试的修复最快。 所有底层引擎的工作都是别人的。本仓库在其之上增加了启动器和补丁队列： - **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)**（MIT）—— 本仓库所基于的原生执行工具链： NSO 重写器、Horizon 宿主层、NVN-on-Metal、各游戏 profile 和 iOS 外壳。 - **[d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile)**（MIT）—— nxnative 由之发展而来的 原始原生执行方案。 - **Ryujinx**（MIT）—— 把 Maxwell 着色器翻译成 SPIR-V 的翻译器。 - **[Atmosphère](https://github.com/Atmosphere-NX/Atmosphere)** —— Horizon 同步语义的参考实现。 - **[LibHac](https://github.com/Thealexbarney/LibHac)** —— `nx_extract` 用它读取 NSP 并叠加更新。 - **[SPIRV-Cross](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Cross)** —— SPIR-V 转 Metal Shading Language。 -
